content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati JRF (GATE) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 29-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati) for hiring eligible candidates on a contractual basis in Assam.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The available post under this recruitment notification issued by IIT Guwahati is JRF (GATE) with a total of 1 vacancy.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Guwahati JRF (GATE) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to successfully submit your online application form for the JRF (GATE) position is 29-09-2026. Ensure you apply well before this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Nil, making it completely free to apply for the advertised position at IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the JRF (GATE) post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the JRF (GATE) position must possess a BTech in CSE or related subjects along with a valid GATE score in CSE.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or stipend offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the JRF (GATE) position will receive a monthly salary amounting to Rs. 44910 Per Month as per the institutional guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIT Guwahati JRF (GATE)?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised JRF (GATE) vacancy purely involves an Interview scheduled to be conducted on 30-09-2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for SC and ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, candidates belonging to SC and ST categories are exempted from paying any application fee, and the fee is listed as Nil in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applications for the JRF (GATE) recruitment must be submitted strictly through Online mode by visiting the official recruitment portal.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website for further updates?
faq.answer: You can check all official updates, download notices, and access the application portal directly by visiting the official website at https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/.
